p: before Eli: The Chaldee text reads "while Eli lived".
precious in those days: Because there were very few prophets to declare it.
place: In the court next to the tabernacle.
lamp of God went out in: That is, the lamps which burnt in the night.
called Samuel: Josephus writes that Samuel was 12 years old when the Lord appeared to him.
perceived that the LORD had called: Such was the corruption of those times that the chief priest had become dull and negligent to understand the Lord's appearing.
tingle: God declares that sudden fear will come on men when they hear that the ark is taken, and see Eli's house destroyed.
ever: Meaning that his posterity would never enjoy the chief priests office.
do so to thee: God punish you after this and that sort, unless you tell me the truth, Ru 1:17.
fall to the ground: The Lord accomplished whatever he had said.
